label: Users
description: Sign-in accounts, employee links, account status and role assignments within the organization.

actions.label: Create
actions.description: Create organization sign-in accounts and assign their employee links and roles.

actions.label: Read
actions.description: View user accounts, employee link options and account access details.

actions.label: Update
actions.description: Update account details, employee links and role assignments; activate or deactivate accounts.

actions.label: Reset password
actions.description: Set a new password for an organization account and revoke its existing sessions.

label: Roles
description: Named permission bundles assigned to users and ranked by access levels.

actions.label: Create
actions.description: Create roles with an access level and explicit organization permissions.

actions.label: Read
actions.description: View role definitions, access levels and available role permissions.

actions.label: Update
actions.description: Update role names, access levels and permission selections; activate or deactivate roles.

label: Levels
description: Hierarchy ranks such as L1 and L2 used to organize roles without inheriting permissions.

actions.label: Create
actions.description: Create a hierarchy level for organization roles.

actions.label: Read
actions.description: View organization hierarchy levels and their status.

actions.label: Update
actions.description: Update hierarchy level details and activate or deactivate a level.

label: Teams
description: Department teams and their memberships used for organization grouping and workflow assignments.

actions.label: Update
actions.description: Update team details and status; add or remove team members.

actions.label: Delete
actions.description: Delete an unused team when membership and workflow references do not prevent deletion.

label: Permissions
description: The application-managed catalog of module permissions and what each permission allows.

actions.label: Read
actions.description: View, search and filter the permission catalog. Permission definitions are maintained by the application.
